acceptanceCriteria: Fixture: app/models/thing.rb (class Thing) and app/controllers/things_controller.rb (Thing.find) with no require: impact on the model lists the controller as a named-constant reverse reference with lower confidence than an import.
The result names the autoload roots and inflection rules applied.
Spec requirement(s) recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1077 (opened 2026-10-17). In a Ruby repository that autoloads constants by path convention, impact returns only the changed path with unknowns reverse-import-rule-unavailable and dynamic-dispatch-unresolved, so a model/service change never reaches its controllers, jobs and views. Request: map each file to the constant its path names (honouring configured autoload roots and inflection overrides), index constant references (full and namespace-relative), report reverse references in their own confidence class below a direct import, keep unknown for metaprogrammed references (constantize, send, string class names), and report the autoload roots and inflections used.
title: impact: reverse references for convention-autoloaded Ruby constants (issue #1077)
